remix_prompt: Streamer Simulator. A satirical game inspired by The Office built around streamer simulator play, with creative, cozy, chill game energy, anti anxiety session design, search-friendly hooks like streamer simulator, casual, addictive, aesthetics like y2k, cottagecore, fairycore, and meme-tone cues such as slay, era. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
